codeReview.summary: Implementation fully covers the feature requirements. The view switcher correctly uses a segmented control, sticky mini calendar incorporates the 7-column grid with event indicators, the day strip for week view works, and the floating bottom action bar is present with the requested buttons. DnD imports were safely avoided and legacy token references were scrubbed from calendar components.
